description: DBTR - Canale di scolo, canaletta irrigua - (CSR_GLI) is a dataset listed in Italian Catalogue of metadata for Spatial Data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by servizigis.regione.emilia-romagna.it. This class defines the entities that constitute surface drainages that, due to their small size, do not participate in the Hydrographic Lattice. Coverage: IT. The portal shows the English title as "DBTR - Drainage channel, irrigation channel - (CSR_GLI)" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS. The listing shows 2025-08-31 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-rndt.
